scope: Compact nonverbal dictionary design; evidence-backed recommendations, not acceptance of a future export. No source/register/shared edits.

print_policy.nouns: Gender plus evidenced genitive singular and nominative plural, in a fixed labelled order. Show an unchanged plural explicitly when evidenced. Add only important stem-changing obliques or variants, with exact case and source qualifiers.
print_policy.adjectives: Citation plus evidenced comparative/superlative and short exceptional-stem note when useful. Do not print regular strong/weak ending lists. Existing degree entries keep their own meanings and receive a link to the positive.
print_policy.adverbs: Invariant citation; add only evidenced comparative/superlative forms, preserving degree-specific meaning. No adjective agreement forms.
print_policy.pronouns_and_determiners: Keep short number/gender/case guidance and selected opaque crossrefs; do not print entire tables as a forms list. Distinguish personal genitives from agreeing possessives.
print_policy.numerals: Keep quantity, agreement and numeral-kind labels; use selected irregular-form pointers, without manufacturing a productive paradigm for supplied high numbers.
print_policy.prepositions_conjunctions_particles: Headword, useful exact spelling variant, meaning and government/construction note. Whole expressions stay whole; no morphological list.
print_policy.proper_names_loans_and_source_forms: Retain exact citation/source-form labels and only evidenced gender/case facts. Do not manufacture Latin/OE paradigms. Source-limited entries remain useful dictionary references.
print_policy.verbs: Use the separately reviewed old-english-dictionary-policy.json; changed-stem present crossrefs follow cross-reference-policy.json.
print_policy.unknown_cells: A missing checked form is omitted, not generated from a usual ending and not declared universally unattested. Known reference forms are not suppressed merely because their teaching status is supplied or recognition-only.
print_policy.editorial_text_handling: Fields named editorial_note, qualifier or instruction describe integration constraints. Do not mechanically print them. Render only actual grammatical labels, selected forms, concise learner notes and sense-specific positive links.

noun_diagnostic_schema_check.normalization: genitive/gen, nominative/nom, singular/sg and plural/pl analysis spellings recognized; no form spelling normalized.
noun_diagnostic_schema_check.production_test: Any registered form with production_taught_in set; all 148 no-diagnostic nouns lack that marker.

noun_display_overrides.gender_qualifier: Also feminine in the supplied source passage.

diagnostics.label: source f. gen. sg.
diagnostics.qualifier: Do not merge the feminine source cell into the masculine genitive alternatives.

noun_display_overrides.suggested_display: sǣ (m.; also f. in the supplied source). gen. sg. sǣs; nom. pl. sǣs; source f. gen. sg. sǣ. sea.

noun_display_overrides.instruction: Move prose out of the gender code. Do not infer a singular or interpret the noun abbreviation as new morphology.
